candidate_name: GNL Zona Sur (San Vicente / Huachipato small-scale LNG terminal)
sponsor_or_proposer: CAP group (Gas Natural Zona Sur SpA) + Enel
current_state: WITHDRAWN from environmental evaluation. A DIA was submitted to Chile's SEIA on 14 Feb (Biobío region, San Vicente bay, reusing CAP Acero's existing dock for small-scale LNG carriers; ~30,000 m3 storage; ~US$104M investment), but CAP/Gas Natural Zona Sur requested withdrawal of the DIA on 18 Dec after ICSARA clarifications. Project discontinued — not currently advancing.
missing_threshold_elements: No active permit (DIA withdrawn), no FID, no construction step; sponsor has shelved it. Does not meet Discovery add-bar.
watch_for: Re-submission of the DIA / a new SEIA filing by CAP+Enel; any revived 'GNL Zona Sur' or San Vicente / Huachipato small-scale LNG terminal. Distinct from the existing GEM 'Talcahuano FSRU' (Inversiones GNL Talcahuano SpA, off Isla de Los Reyes) and from 'Penco Lirquén FSRU' — do not merge.
notes: Surfaced during Talcahuano update research. Flagging for the concurrent Discovery agent / future discovery pass; out of scope for this Update worklist.
